# NeoBank

> NeoBank is a fullstack demo banking platform by Dawid Olko, built with Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Prisma and PostgreSQL. Customers hold multi-currency accounts and move money through a double-entry ledger. It is not a real bank.

## Pages

- [Home](https://neobank.dawidolko.pl/): what the platform does and how it is built
- [Sign in](https://neobank.dawidolko.pl/login): access to an existing account
- [Open an account](https://neobank.dawidolko.pl/register): registration for a demo account

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
